title: WorkloadPreset
description: A named, versioned workload with suggested SLOs. Files live in schema/presets/<name>.v<version>.yaml. The workload block is immutable once released (a change is a new version), so a preset name always means one request mix; slos and rps_hint are suggestions outside the workload hash and may be corrected in place.

name.description: Lower-case words joined by hyphens; the file name starts with it.

engines.description: The engines that can run this workload. bench rejects the preset on any other.

slos.description: Suggested SLOs. The New run view copies them into the RunSpec; bench never applies them implicitly.

rps_hint.description: Hand-written starting points per GPU class for the load ladder, not measured capacity.

presetWorkload.description: The workload fields a preset fixes. streaming is the RunSpec's choice, and seed is not part of a workload's identity.

gpu_class.description: A GPU class label such as a100-80gb.

start_rps.description: Offered RPS of the first ladder stage.
